decision: Automated cross-validation of von Neumann linear stability analysis for D2Q9 LBM (BGK/MRT): the analytic amplification-matrix eigenvalues must match measured modal growth rates from full nonlinear periodic-box integration within predeclared thresholds.

alternatives.A_analytic_only: von Neumann eigenvalue analysis only (no measurement) -- rejected: no cross-validation against actual solver behavior
alternatives.B_measurement_only: periodic-box integration only (no analytic prediction) -- rejected: no reference to validate against
alternatives.C_selected: both arms: analytic von Neumann prediction + measured modal growth from nonlinear LBM, compared point-by-point with predeclared thresholds

hypothesis: H1: The measured modal growth rate from full nonlinear LBM integration matches the von Neumann eigenvalue prediction to within 5% relative error for all stable points, and the stability boundary (tau=0.5) is correctly identified. H0 (falsifier): any point has >5% relative error in growth rate, or the stability boundary is misidentified.

metrics.growth_rel_err: relative error |sigma_measured - sigma_predicted| / |sigma_predicted| for the shear branch
metrics.phase_speed_rel_err: relative error |c_measured - c_predicted| / |c_predicted| for acoustic branches
metrics.lambda_max: spectral radius max|mu| across all wave vectors
metrics.viscosity_rel_err: relative error |nu_num - nu_CE| / nu_CE from equivalent equation fit
metrics.fit_r2: R-squared of the exponential fit to modal amplitude
metrics.purity: fraction of modal energy in the target branch

unit_of_analysis: one (tau, Ma, theta, collision_model) point; each point has an analytic prediction and a measured growth rate

baseline_control.baseline: Chapman-Enskog viscosity nu = (tau - 0.5)/3 for BGK at Ma=0, theta->0
baseline_control.control: von Neumann eigenvalue at theta->0 must recover nu_CE to within 1%

predeclared_thresholds.gate_rule: all C1-C4 criteria must pass; individual point errors >15% are FAIL

acceptance_rule: every declared criterion (C1-C4) must pass; a failed criterion is reported as FAIL, never dropped

C1_physical_shear.note: physical shear seed, vorticity observable, error < 5%

C2_stability_boundary.note: stability boundary: tau<0.5 should be unstable, tau>0.5 stable

C3_equivalent_equation.note: nu_num(theta) = a + b*theta^2 fit, max rel dev < 10%

variables_held_fixed: MRT rates: s_e=1.64, s_eps=1.54, s_q=1.7 (when applicable)
confounders: the nonlinear LBM has O(Ma^2) compressibility effects not present in the linear analysis -- measurable through the Ma sensitivity arm
finite box size discretizes the wave vector spectrum; the analytic prediction uses the exact box-grid wave vectors, not a continuum
at tau=1 the BGK kinetic eigenvalues vanish and the kinetic subspace becomes degenerate -- eigenvector continuation is required for mode identification
float64 round-off sets a noise floor of ~1e-16 for modal amplitude; the fit window must stay above 1e-12
repetitions: each design cell is deterministic (no RNG, fixed step count), so one run per cell; reproducibility is asserted by re-running the main cell twice and requiring bitwise equality
analysis: KPIs compared pairwise per design cell; no outlier removal; no post-hoc threshold change; the decision is the gate verdict on H1 plus the emitted negative-knowledge set for any failed criterion

environment.compute: local for quick validation; cluster for full campaign if >10min

stopping_rule: each arm stops at the predeclared step budget or when the modal amplitude exits the linear band; no arm is extended after looking at KPI values
fail_stage_plan: fail_stage names the stage (analytic / measurement / comparison / gate / report) and failure_reason carries the measured deviation or the exception text
external_anchor: Sterling & Chen (1996) JCP 123:196-206; Lallemand & Luo (2000) PRE 61:6546
